ns2:course.label: Sem 20thC Spanish Lit
ns2:course.description: Investigation of literary problems presented by the Spanish novel, drama, poetry and/or essay since 1900. Instruction in Spanish unless otherwise noted. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: SPAN 465 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
